content.outro: The roll lies open on the lectern under the lantern, and the chapel is ready for the morning.
content.premise: Tomorrow at first light the men of Wending Cross answer to their names in the chapel, and the names are read from the loft. The roll has spent the year in the vestry chest. Tonight it goes up the loft stair and onto the lectern, and a lantern goes on the hook above it, so that whoever keeps the night watch can see the names are still there.
content.theme: A small parish chapel at dusk, where the muster roll is laid on the loft lectern and a lantern is hung over it for the night.
content.title: An Item Laid at a Place
